Rule.Title: MISSION TACTICS
Rule.Text:
Friendly KILL TEAM units with this ability have the following abilities:
Furor Tactics
When the enemy horde grows close, the Deathwatch will be tasked with the decimation of their core. Aiming not for clinical kills but for maximum destruction over a wide area, they tear the heart from the enemy army.If the devastator doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
Malleus Tactics
When the giants of war lumber forth, the Deathwatch will adopt Malleus tactics. Even the largest behemoth has a weak point, and the archives of the Deathwatch number them all.If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks have [LETHAL HITS].
Purgatus Tactics
By adopting Purgatus tactics, the Deathwatch focus their deadly ire upon the commanders of the enemy host, assassinating them one after another with pitiless head shots and killing thrusts of the blade.If the assault doctrine is active for your unit, your unit’s attacks that target an enemy unit within 9" of this unit have [PRECISION].
DEATHWATCH ALLIES
You can include Deathwatch units in your army, even though they do not have the same Chapter faction keyword as other units in your army. The combined points value of such units cannot exceed 500 points.
When mustering your army, unless otherwise stated, you cannot select a Deathwatch model to be your Warlord. In addition Kill Team units can only contain enhancements taken from this detachment.
This an exception to the Space Marine Chapters Army Rules.

Stratagems.Name: Hurtling Targets
Stratagems.When: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Astartes Mounted/Speeder unit.
Stratagems.Effect: Ranged attacks that target your unit have -1 to hit rolls.

Enhancements.Name: Auspex Triangulation Shrines (Upgrade)
Enhancements.Description:
Adeptus Astartes speeder unit only. At the start of your Shooting phase, select one visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit. That enemy unit is spotted:
While a unit is spotted, that unit has +3" detection range.

Enhancements.Name: Supercharged Engines (Upgrade)
Enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes Mounted unit only. This unit can re-roll advance rolls.

Stratagems.Name: Armour Of Contempt
Stratagems.When: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit.
Stratagems.Effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 AP until that enemy unit has attacked.

Stratagems.Name: Domination Fire
Stratagems.When: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit has shot.
Stratagems.Effect:
Select one enemy unit hit by those attacks. That enemy unit is suppressed until the start of your next turn:
While a unit is suppressed, that unit’s attacks have -1 to hit rolls.

Stratagems.Name: Masterful Tactics
Stratagems.When: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Adeptus Astartes Infantry/Mounted unit.
Stratagems.Effect:
Your unit can make a normal move of:
Up to D6". Or: If the tactical doctrine is active for your unit, up to 6".

Rule.Title: TACTICAL MASTERY
Rule.Text: You can select the tactical doctrine one additional time per battle.

Enhancements.Name: Laurels of Vigilance
Enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes model only.(Once per battle round, per army) When you use the Fire Overwatch/Heroic Intervention stratagem, if you target a friendly Adeptus Astartes Battleline unit within 12" of this model with that stratagem, that use is -1 CP.

Enhancements.Name: Tactical Insight
Enhancements.Description: Captain model only. The tactical doctrine is active for this unit in addition to any other combat doctrine.

Stratagems.Name: Tactical Focus
Stratagems.When: Fight phase, when a friendly Tacticus unit is selected to make a consolidation move.
Stratagems.Effect: When making that consolidation move, your unit can move up to D3+3".

Stratagems.Name: Relentless Assault
Stratagems.When: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Tacticus unit is selected to attack.
Stratagems.Effect:
Your unit’s attacks have:
[Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle]. Or: [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

Stratagems.Name: Transhuman Swiftness
Stratagems.When: Fight phase, when an enemy unit has fought.
Stratagems.Target: One friendly Tacticus unit that is within range of an objective and is eligible to fight.
Stratagems.Effect: Your unit has Fights First and must be the next unit you select to fight.

Rule.Title: WRATH OF THE CHAPTER
Rule.Text: Friendly Tacticus units can re-roll advance rolls.

Enhancements.Name: Martial Paragon
Enhancements.Description:
Tacticus model only. This unit’s attacks can:
Re-roll one hit roll. Re-roll one wound roll.

Enhancements.Name: Spearpoint War Leader
Enhancements.Description: Tacticus model only. This unit has Scouts 6".

Stratagems.Name: Point-Blank Brutality
Stratagems.When: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly engaged Tacticus unit is selected to shoot.
Stratagems.Effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks (excluding [Blast] attacks) have:
[Close-Quarters]. [Ignores Cover].

Stratagems.Name: For The Emperor!
Stratagems.When: Command phase.
Stratagems.Target: One friendly Tacticus unit that is within range of an objective.
Stratagems.Effect: Your unit has +1 OC until the end of the turn.

Stratagems.Name: Relentless Assault
Stratagems.When: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Tacticus unit is selected to attack.
Stratagems.Effect:
Your unit’s attacks have:
[Sustained Hits 1: non-Monster/Vehicle]. Or: [Lethal Hits: Monster/Vehicle].

Rule.Title: CODEX FIRE-PATTERNS
Rule.Text: Friendly Tacticus units’ [Rapid Fire] attacks benefit from [Rapid Fire] when targeting units up to that attack’s maximum range.

Enhancements.Name: Cyber-familiar
Enhancements.Description: Tacticus model only. When both players have deployed their armies, you can redeploy up to three friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry units. When doing so, you can set those units up in strategic reserves, regardless of how many units are already in strategic reserves.

Enhancements.Name: Tempered in Battle (Aura)
Enhancements.Description: Tacticus model only. Friendly Adeptus Astartes units within 6" of this model can re-roll leadership rolls.

Stratagems.Name: Tactical Dreadnought Fortitude
Stratagems.When: Your opponent’s Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly adeptus astartes Terminator unit.
Stratagems.Effect: Attacks that target your unit have -1 D until that enemy unit has attacked.

Stratagems.Name: Merciless Veterans
Stratagems.When: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly adeptus astartes Terminator unit is selected to shoot.
Stratagems.Effect:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have:
[Lethal Hits]. [Sustained Hits 1].

Stratagems.Name: Gunship Extraction
Stratagems.When: End of your opponent’s Fight phase.
Stratagems.Target: One friendly unengaged adeptus astartes terminator unit.
Stratagems.Effect: Place your unit in strategic reserves.

Rule.Title: DEATH BLOW
Rule.Text: Friendly Adeptus Astartes Terminator units have +1 to charge rolls.

Enhancements.Name: Champion of the First Company
Enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. This unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

Enhancements.Name: Corporeum Reliquary
Enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes Terminator model only. In your first Movement phase, this unit can make an ingress move.

Stratagems.Name: For The Emperor'S Honour!
Stratagems.When: The Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit is selected to fight.
Stratagems.Effect: Your unit’s melee attacks have [PRECISION].

Stratagems.Name: Pious Enmity
Stratagems.When: Fight phase, when a friendly Chaplain/Judiciar unit is selected to fight.
Stratagems.Effect: Your unit’s melee attacks can re-roll hit rolls of 1. Or: Your unit’s melee attacks that target a Monster/Vehicle unit can re-roll hit rolls of 1 and wound rolls of 1.

Stratagems.Name: Devout Push
Stratagems.When: Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit is selected to make a pile-in/consolidation move.
Stratagems.Effect: When making that pile-in/consolidation move, your unit can move up to D3+3".

Stratagems.Name: Heresy Begets Retribution
Stratagems.When: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit.
Stratagems.Effect: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6".

Stratagems.Name: Dread Crusaders
Stratagems.When: Your opponent’s Charge phase, when an enemy unit selects charge targets.
Stratagems.Target: One Adeptus Astartes Infantry unit that was selected as a charge target by that enemy unit this phase.
Stratagems.Effect: That enemy unit must make a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that battle-shock roll.

Stratagems.Name: Spoor Of The Unholy
Stratagems.When: Your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when a friendly Adeptus Astartes unit is selected to attack.
Stratagems.Effect:
Your unit can ignore modifiers to your unit’s:
BS and WS. Hit rolls.

Rule.Title: TEMPLAR VOWS
Rule.Text:
At the start of the first battle round, you can select one Vow listed below. That Vow is active for friendly Adeptus Astartes units until the end of the battle.
Abhor the Witch, Destroy the Witch
This unit’s melee attacks that target a Psyker unit:
▪ Have [PRECISION].
▪ Have [LANCE].
Accept Any Challenge, No Matter the Odds
Friendly melee attacks that target a unit with a T greater than this unit’s S have +1 to wound rolls.
Uphold the Honour of the Emperor
Friendly Infantry units have:
▪ At the end of your Movement phase, if this unit is controlling an objective, that objective is secured.
▪ When this unit is selected to make an advance move, that advance move does not prevent this unit from being eligible to start an action.
Restrictions: Your army can include Black Templars units, but it cannot include any Adeptus Astartes units drawn from any other Chapter.

Enhancements.Name: Augury Servo-host
Enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes model only. In your Shooting phase, you can select one visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit. That enemy unit cannot have the benefit of cover.

Enhancements.Name: Consecrating Aura
Enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes model only. This unit has 5+ InSv.

Enhancements.Name: Incendiary Animus
Enhancements.Description: Chaplain/Judiciar model only. This unit’s melee attacks have +1 S.

Enhancements.Name: Zealous Vanguard
Enhancements.Description: Adeptus Astartes model only. This unit has Scouts 6".

ArmyRules.Title: TEMPLAR VOWS
ArmyRules.Text: If your Army Faction is Adeptus Astartes, at the start of the first battle round, select one of the following Vows to be active for Adeptus Astartes units from your army. While a Vow is active for your army, that unit has the associated ability below. Abhor the Witch, Destroy the Witch ■ Each time this unit declares a charge, if one or more targets of that charge have the Psyker keyword, you can re-roll the Charge roll. Melee weapons equipped by models in this unit have the [PRECISION] ability while targeting Psyker units. Accept Any Challenge, No Matter the Odds ■ Each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, if the Strength characteristic of that attack is less than or equal to the Toughness characteristic of the target, add 1 to the wound roll Suffer Not the Unclean to Live ■ This unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back, and each time a model in this unit makes a Pile-in or Consolidation move, it does not need to end that move closer to the closest enemy model, provided it ends that move as close as possible to the nearest enemy unit. Uphold the Honour of the Emperor If this unit has the Infantry keyword: ■ At the end of your Command phase, if this unit is within range of an objective marker you control, that objective marker remains under your control until your opponent's level of control over that objective marker is greater than yours at the end of the phase. ■ If the mission you are playing features Actions, this unit is eligible to start to perform an Action in a turn in which it Advanced.

ArmyRules.Title: HEIRS OF SIGISMUND
ArmyRules.Text:
If an Adeptus Astartes unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that Faction keyword is the name of that unit’s Chapter. For example, High Marshal Helbrecht has both the Adeptus Astartes and Black Templars Faction keywords, and is therefore from the Black Templars Chapter.

You cannot include units from more than one Chapter in your army.

If your army includes one or more units from the Black Templars Chapter or you are using one of the Detachments found on the following pages:

Adeptus Astartes units from your army lose the Oath of Moment army rule (if they have it), and it is replaced with the Templar Vows army rule.

You cannot use the 1st Company Task Force Detachment (see Codex: Space Marines).

Your army cannot include any **Adeptus Astartes Psyker** models.

Your army cannot include the following datasheets from Codex: Space Marines: Gladiator Lancer; Gladiator Reaper; Gladiator Valiant; Impulsor; Land Raider Crusader; Repulsor; Repulsor Executioner; Sternguard Veteran Squad; Terminator Squad.
